tasks.fix: Replace per-keystroke tokio::spawn with a single long-lived forwarder task consuming from an unbounded mpsc channel. Char coalescing via try_recv() batches consecutive Text messages. Keys and session switches flush pending text first.

tasks.finding: F-002 — CACHED_MANAGER stale after daemon restart
tasks.fix: Add reconnect fallback in connect_cached(). When a send* method returns an io::Error (not just PaneNotFound/OwnedSessionLeaseLost), call CACHED_MANAGER.take() or replace the cell, reconnect, and retry. Alternatively: expose a connect_or_reconnect() that re-initializes the cell on connection-level errors.

tasks.fix: Change async_status from Arc<Mutex<Option<String>>> to Arc<Mutex<Vec<String>>>. Main loop drains the Vec and joins messages. Alternatively use a tokio::sync::mpsc::unbounded_channel for zero-lock status delivery.
